featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the hospital for blood donation with a genuine intention to help others. During the screening, I was told that my hemoglobin level was low. However, after further tests, everything came out normal and there was no health issue found.

I feel the staff handling the blood donation process need better training and proper knowledge. Hiring inexperienced staff without enough medical understanding can create unnecessary fear and confusion for donors. Because of this, people who come forward for a good cause may feel discouraged from donating blood again.

I hope the hospital management improves staff training and ensures accurate guidance is given to donors in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m writing this review to share my feedback on the health check-up packages at MM Medicals (IC Colony). At one point, their services were excellent, but over the years I’ve noticed a noticeable decline.
I visit India once every one to two years and get an annual full body check-up and recently opted for their cardiac health package. Below is my experience:
* The stress test is conducted barefoot on a treadmill. While I understand the purpose of the test, walking barefoot resulted in painful blisters on both my feet. This raised concerns for me, especially for senior citizens—such as my parents, who also use these packages—or anyone with sensitive feet. It felt unsafe and unnecessarily uncomfortable.
* All doctor consultations are conducted with open doors, making it possible for medical history and health concerns to be overheard by patients in nearby rooms. This was uncomfortable and raises serious concerns about patient privacy.
* After completing the tests, the package includes consultations with various doctors to review the reports. Unfortunately, I did not find these consultations helpful and had to seek opinions from doctors elsewhere to properly understand my results.
* I would also like to highlight an unpleasant incident involving the radiologist performing the sonography. She was openly rude to the front-line staff, yelling at them in front of patients. This was upsetting to witness and completely unfair. In contrast, the front-line staff were extremely hardworking, professional, and courteous—the best part of my experience. Respect and kindness should be extended to staff at all levels.
* Lastly, I was not informed in advance that there was no gynecologist available, which was one of the key consultations I needed. Although I was able to meet her briefly, I was unable to get a follow-up after my Pap smear results arrived, which was very disappointing.

Overall, I hope MM Medical takes this feedback seriously and addresses these issues. With meaningful improvements, it has the potential to return to the high standard of service it once provided.
